reveal_en: Light from distant stars travels for eons. When it finally reaches your eye, you are seeing the universe's past.
reveal_zh: 遥远星光穿越亿万年抵达。你所见的，是宇宙最古老的过去。
meaning_en: Every glimmer connects you to a journey through time, a memory of celestial bodies that might have transformed or ceased to be. You witness their enduring echo.
meaning_zh: 每次闪烁都连接着一场穿越时空的旅程。它是一颗星辰可能已消逝，却永恒回响的记忆。

visual.color: Deep indigo, shimmering silver, faint gold
visual.motion: Slow, ethereal drift of stardust; subtle pulsation of light
